plugins.description: Prompt for custom block IDs and complete wiki block links to open tasks, with a plan-budget suffix. Typing (( opens the Task Wikilink Picker to insert a [[note#^id]] link to any vault task. Ctrl+Shift+Enter refuses Depends-On ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** dependency lines. On inbox notes, a Ctrl+Shift+Enter link asks where the task goes first, and Link to today then suggests the destination's type; an unlink asks right before writing, then moves it with the toggle applied (nav inboxRoute v1). Unlinking an In Progress task with no live link left today offers configured starts-after successors through task-status-cycler api v4. Ctrl+Shift+Enter asks which of today's Pomodoros to link into (↵ = suggested, else current/next, type to filter or name a new one). Project Schedule comes from the ^prj task; a future-scheduled ^prj link is refused only when its date is the sole remaining reason, dependency reasons are reported first, and a direct link raises a Ready ^prj to Next. A tagged #prj_is_blocked ^prj is refused as blocked by its parent project without raising prerequisites. Ctrl+Shift+Enter refuses LINKS with the relation notice and LINKED FROM with the generated-line notice; Pomodoro cleanup skips both. Link to today also offers recent task types with component swatches and near-duplicate hints; Ctrl+D hides or restores Recent suggestions only. The block ID prompt also suggests an ID for a plain note bullet (a notebook note), ignoring its [created::] stamp.
Format Bob article notes with bob on save, when leaving, or on command, and preview article adoption.
Run bob commands from Obsidian with safe-write guards, run history, and an automation API.
Complete GitHub-style emoji shortcodes from a colon typed after a space.

vault_ignore.warning: plugin bob-emoji vault folder .obsidian/plugins/bob-emoji has 3 tracked files (.obsidian/plugins/bob-emoji/main.js, .obsidian/plugins/bob-emoji/manifest.json, .obsidian/plugins/bob-emoji/styles.css) in vault Git. Remove them from the index and add `.obsidian/plugins/bob-emoji/` to the vault .gitignore so deploys stay out of version control. bob never runs `git rm --cached`: untracking on one host deletes the files on the others at their next pull.

plugins.description: Expand Bob daily-note snippets and ledger time ranges, navigate and adjust Pomodoro entries, render the live plan-budget bob-plan block, track task freshness including [unblocked::] TICKLERs, render [priority::] fields as signal-bar priority marks, render display-only blocked-reason marks on visible Live Preview and rendered source-note task rows (Reading view, embeds, hover previews, and Dataview TASK views) with accessible tooltips, a session toggle, and cache-aware refresh, plus CSS-only marks in Tasks query results; expose the classifier and listener-free miniature renderer through api.blockMarks v1 with gated held/waiting/stale checkbox paint, render created/scheduled/completion/cancelled dates and `[repeat:: …]` rules as compact date-family marks (including date and recurrence marks in full and short Tasks query results), render `#task` tags as a teal hash task-tag mark (hidden in Tasks query results) and `#task #ref` pairs as an open-book ref mark, `#task #prj` pairs as a teal target mark, and exact `#hide` tags as a grey eye-off mark, and render canonical `#task #gtd #pre` / `#task #gtd #post` runs as teal sunrise / flag identity marks with quiet small-caps stage labels for configured stages across Live Preview and reading view (Tasks rows keep native pills) and Tasks rows. Render Depends-On lines as live dependency chips plus generated BLOCKS rows with live dependents, last-blocker keys, stale-entry styling, and frees-N summaries. Blocked chips draw the target's miniature block mark and reason line. Open BLOCKS rows add ＋ / hover × through nav api.blocks when present. Index raw task LINKS rows plus inert text mentions through api.relationIndex v2, with unsaved editor overlays, typed linkedFrom rows, a pure scanMentions helper, and label suggestions. Render Task Links under today's open Pomodoros with In Progress half-ring marks and read-time unblocked hand-off glyphs. Add a quiet 🔑 frees N mark after Task Links whose linked task is the last blocker of N open tasks, with a tooltip naming the freed tasks and a session toggle. Fetch `bob stats` JSON with stale-while-revalidate caching and render the responsive Stats page `bob-stats` block with metric-family context, accessible daily drill-down, definition disclosures, tiles, window time bars, and table. Fetch `bob ref list` JSON with a bounded stale-while-revalidate cache, decode audio paths, and provide pure Reading Board lane, card, Snoozed group, ordering, and validated fence models. Render the read-only `bob-reading-board` code block, a Reading / Next / Ready / Snoozed kanban of the reading queue drawn entirely from `bob ref list` JSON (wake dates and waiting-on reasons from bob, never from vault text), with keyed background refresh errors, repaint-safe navigation, roving keyboard focus, click and modifier routing to Obsidian navigation, the optional Highlights PDF hand-off through nav `openReferencePdf`, and the Open Reading Board command. Derive quiet lowercase Pomodoro home chips that name each linked task's root parent in Live Preview and Reading view, with area-hue dots, a tooltip, and a toggle. Show a display-only 🍅 Today mark on open task lines linked under today's open Pomodoros in Live Preview and Reading view, with a session toggle and jumps to the Task Link. Task relation lines are excluded from the plan Task Link count. Render 🪢 LINKS and LINKED FROM rows as live relation chips from that index, with label pills, inverse phrases, stale and broken styling, closed-row collapse, and ＋ / hover × through nav api.relations v1 when present. The footer shows the Alt+P preview on review rows and on any open task with a priority, including a hint-only footer when nothing is due; staged PRE/POST rows show their uppercase stage and a stage-local count when multiple rows are due, also in landing toasts. Each review group is painted in its tier color. In source-note Live Preview and Reading view, the freshness mark tooltip adds a per-rung tally line (`🥀 WIP 2 · Next 1 · last <date> — <reason>`) from the task's Rotten Log; Tasks and Dataview query rows never show it. Share the task type catalog through api.themes v1 and render Pomodoro name type pills with stable hues in Live Preview, Reading view, the plan block, and the Stats Types panel, with a session toggle; render explicit [type:: NAME] task fields as a colored #TYPE in the #task slot (folding the field, no trailing pill) with inherited-type and type-mark session toggles, mark disagreeing Task Links in today's ledger, and keep type colors active in every window. Render the read-only Day strip above the bob-plan badges of canonical daily notes with a quiet typical-day line under each numeric fact, support the bob-day-stats fence, and provide the Toggle Day stats session command and the Cycle Day stats bars command. api.laneWalk v2 serves the Pending/Next/Ready-off-Today walk list behind the navigation ]w / [w and ]W / [W keys. Run quiet `bob gcal sync` after the current daily note is created and paint Event Tasks and context rows (a dashed time pill and mark for `#offclock` Event Tasks, with `#off-clock` and `#untracked` as aliases) in Live Preview and Reading view, with `se<X>` starts that follow a MEET's event run, write `[off:: Nm]` instead of `[t:: Nm]` for an off-clock lineup, and warn before running into an event. An Off-Clock Pomodoro's home chip is dashed and shows its recorded minutes. Render a small status ring in front of every rendered link whose target is a `#task` line, with a session toggle. Render the same Event time pill before ledger Task Links to one of the note's Event Tasks, with its own session toggle; calendar event painting must also be on. Add a report-driven Worked, Off-clock, and Total clock chooser to Stats with per-device preference and clock-specific fetch caching, and render Off-clock dashed outlines and Total worked/off-clock tails in tiles, focus charts, window lanes, and time breakdowns, plus a Day strip off-clock hint below WORKED that opens the day's Off-clock lens. Show a shared dashed timer-off off chip after ledger Task Links whose task resolves off-clock, tagged or inherited, in Live Preview and Reading view. Expose task-merge writes through api.taskMerge v1: the Links stage previews a configured merge label with `bob task merge --dry-run -f json` and commits with picks, desktop-only. The api.notebooks v1 namespace runs bob notebooks create for the navigation plugin. Render linked notebook headers with ancestry and child chips in both views, with a Notebook chips setting. On TICKLER rows the Alt+P preview renders as a tier-tinted answer chip with a keycap (red when it would cancel), and it outlasts the meter as the bar narrows. Show a display-only count beside the last planned Task Link in a sub-project, with offered lanes, folded-task counts, a caret jump, modifier-click navigation, and a session toggle. Render `bob-bank` month and queue cards with bounded report fetching, safe existing-heading navigation, per-row acknowledgment, and a report-driven daily chip. Decorate bank month rows and day headings in both views. Render owner album cards with live counts, lead-group peeks and navigation, last-added ages, and shared sync/retry controls.
Link, open, refresh, and send saved Gmail threads from Obsidian.

`[S` / `]S` jump to the first task of the previous / next occupied review group, cycling. Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews. Ctrl+Shift+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `b`: it opens the Task Card's Depends on stage for the task, a Task Link's linked task, or a counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+B>` batch; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `⇧B`: it opens the Blocks stage for a task or Task Link, supports counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B>`, and works from Depends-On and BLOCKS lines, where Ctrl+Shift+P on a BLOCKS line also opens the owner’s stage directly. On an inbox task every non-closing Task Card answer, the Ctrl+Shift+Enter toggle, and Alt+N ask where the task goes before writing and move there. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a stamped `*YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM*` entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F ask due WIP and Next tasks why they stay on their rung, and ask due Ready keeps why they stay; every counted keep on every rung writes one rung-qualified Rotten Log entry in one undo (blank logs no reason given), while early and Today-linked lane keeps stamp quietly with no prompt and no entry. Freshness gestures never ask for or write a Work Log summary. Counted N<Alt+F> and Task Link sessions show one Keep reason prompt; one Enter submits it. Each counted keep gets its own rung-qualified entry; Ready at-limit targets still skip unstamped and unlogged. The decay card shows the logged keeps in its header; Enter steps one rung (WIP → Next → Ready → priority, with the bottom level rolling in place), while Alt+F opens Stay and records its reason in Rotten Log. Step and Drop also log their rung event in the same undo as the task change; Ready alone offers Less often and explicit levels. On a landed RECURRING row both write nothing, show the recurring-tier notice, and stay. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3). Stage-ending completions append `· STAGE ✓`. `]s` / `[s` away from the current review task first return to it. The Task Card level strip and priority notices render the shared signal-bar priority mark through the bob-ledger-tools api.priorityMarks v1 namespace, falling back to the Lucide signal icons without it. The Task Card header's BLOCKED lane chip renders the shared blocked-reason miniature with its After / Until / Via reason list through the bob-ledger-tools api.blockMarks v1 namespace, and the P1-P4 strip shows a hollow teaching digit beside each level's bars, both falling back to today's look without it. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress — asking once for an optional Work Log summary when moving back to Next — through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace. Closing a planned task opens one grouped successor picker when offers exist; nothing starts selected, and the cycler applies only chosen links. Successor picker v2 and notice v2 also present a leaf project's keep-moving offers: a ⏭ Keep ‹project› moving group with a why caption, a "not dependents" tag, lane names instead of status symbols, and one blocked / scheduled later / hidden fold line, rendered last in a mixed picker. Successor picker v3 and notice v3 present relation offers as a 🪢 group titled ‹Label› “‹T›”, with a why caption, a "your links · not dependents" tag, a fold line, lane names, and the link-2 header icon when every group is relational. The pulled-in summary is shown through nav api.notice v3. Review-row closes append the cycler's additive `successorNotice` line to the walk toast. Journals each counted ]s answer, with its outcome, through the bob-ledger-tools api.stats namespace. Depends-On writes now mirror open dependents into generated 🧱 BLOCKS lines, in the same-note transaction or a checked cross-note follow-up, including counted, marked, Ctrl+D, hand-edit (and undo), conversion, and Ctrl+Shift+M paths. Adding an open prerequisite from Ctrl+Shift+P consumes the newly Blocked task's live links from today's open Pomodoros by resolved task identity; link-only bullets with child notes become the task's clean display text and keep those notes. It removes only entries this gesture emptied, leaves childless placeholders alone, and preserves closed timed rows. Cmd+Enter on a reading task, Task Link, or managed embed opens its source_pdf in Highlights without vault writes, while other targets retain Obsidian’s new-tab behavior. Turns on Templater's device-local "Trigger on file creation" when it is unset, so Cmd+N and other new notes get the vault's folder template (_templates/new_note.md). Only the BLOCKS chips in bob-ledger-tools use nav `api.blocks` v1, for ＋ and hover ×. The nav api gains an additive `openReferencePdf(path)` member (Promise of `{ok, reason?}`; the api `version` is unchanged) so the bob-ledger-tools Reading Board can hand a reference PDF to Highlights without vault writes. `Z` (mapped in the vault vimrc) or the "Zoom image on cursor line" command opens the image on the cursor line — an embed, image link, or Markdown image — in a full-window viewer with keyboard and mouse zoom and pan, importing a bullet holding only an image path through bob first; `y` copies its recorded original path (or the vault path / URL), and `r` restores only the picked link to a present recorded original path in one undoable edit. Native image clicks are unchanged. Task relations use 🪢 LINKS and generated LINKED FROM rows; nav api.relations v1 opens either stage and removes live links. The Task Card offers Links to (l) and Linked from (⇧L), with Ctrl+Shift+L and Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L commands; on a Task Link they open the linked task's stage in its own note, and on a Depends-On line they open the owner's. CURRENT shows existing links or sources, Enter applies or removes, Ctrl+Enter edits a relation label, `~` in the filter flips direction, and Ctrl+D clears all outgoing Links to relations while refusing generated Linked from rows. Counted Ctrl+Shift+L applies one target to every selected source; reverse counted links are refused. Alt+P applies the Task Card recommendation in one key, sets P1 on a task with no priority, stays hidden for immediate rolls and decays, and waits on the visible card before cancellation. `]s` landings end their toast with the `Alt+P` roll preview from nav `api.quickRoll` v1. Pomodoro move and rename pickers offer recent task types with component swatches and near-duplicate hints; rename previews count linked task type changes; Ctrl+D hides or restores Recent suggestions only. `]w` / `[w` (mapped in the vault vimrc) walk Pending, Next, and Ready tasks off today's plan — the dash PENDING/NEXT/READY sections — with a lane-colored toast and walk rail; `]W` / `[W` jump to the first task of the next / previous lane, cycling. [n` / `]n` (mapped in the vault vimrc) open the note's previous / next labeled link; `]]` / `[[` repeat the last bracket walk — `]s` review, `]w` lanes, or `]n` links — forward / backward, remembered per device. `]}` / `[{` repeat that family's uppercase jump — `]S` / `[S` review groups or `]W` / `[W` lanes. Ctrl+Shift+- changes the current note's parent: a panel pre-filled with the current parent ranks existing notes, previews the new ancestry, refuses cycles, and rewrites only the `parent:` frontmatter line as a quoted wikilink in one undo. The status bar always shows the bracket-repeat mode as `[[ s w n ]]` with the active walk lit; click a letter to switch. Ctrl+S splits the selected open merged Pomodoro by type: two types split the right one at once, three or more open a picker with an All row and Tab-marked type rows, and the Bob: Split Pomodoro by type palette command does the same with no default hotkey. Ctrl+Shift+T splits the bullet under the cursor into its own task (counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+T>` takes that bullet plus the next N siblings, and a visual selection splits every touched head line), leaving a live link stub and landing the cursor on the first new task in one undo. A merge label in Ctrl+Shift+L, counted Ctrl+Shift+L, and Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L previews and commits through `bob task merge` via the Bob Ledger Tools api.taskMerge namespace, with the consequence strip, an offer pick, an Undo merge notice, and a mobile refusal. `api.quickRoll` previews carry additive `parts`. Delete current file asks for y before trashing an established, journal, bob-managed, or parent note, or any file right after another delete; fresh notes still delete at once. Disk reloads of an open note stay out of that editor's undo history, so Ctrl+R survives background writes and u undoes your own edit.
Keep project task counts materialized in frontmatter.
Add vim-surround ys motions, cs changes, ds deletes, and dot-repeat to Obsidian Vim mode.
Briefly highlight the exact text a Vim yank copies in Obsidian's Vim mode.

Complete Pomodoros while carrying worked-on/deferred links, narrowing the closed name to worked types and shedding uncarried types from the created Pomodoro, and copying each Task Link sub-bullet's sub-sub-bullets into the linked task's Work Log, toggle empty Pomodoro placeholders/sub-bullets with Ctrl+Alt+] including named placeholders, toggle Obsidian tasks with Ctrl+Shift+] (a Vim count N<Ctrl+Shift+]> toggles the cursor item and the next N sibling items together, prompting at most once and sending the whole group to one section) — always prompting for promotion destinations when exact Tasks exists (Enter defaults to Tasks conversion, including in place when already there; typing creates a new section; non-Tasks stays plain; empty non-Tasks source sections are removed) and for demotions from Tasks — cycle Blocked tasks out with option+[/option+], recover affected Blocked dependents, propagate Ctrl+Enter to embedded task transclusions, and preserve embedded-task behavior. Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link closes the linked task and strikes the link, embedded or plain. A versioned `api.recoverBlockedDependents` lets other plugins recover Blocked dependents without retiring references; dependents with a strictly future `scheduled` date stay Blocked, and Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link to a Cancelled task shows a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro. Depends-On lines (managed ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** child bullets) are never struck, restored, reformatted, or tree-closed: Ctrl+Enter closes or reopens the linked prerequisite only, and Alt+[ / Alt+] cycle the link under the cursor. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the bob-navigation-hotkeys review walk just landed on hands off to nav api v2, which completes the row and advances within its group when another live row remains. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link instead toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace, never reformatting the bullet. Closing a planned task recovers what it unblocked and offers successor choices through nav `api.successors` v3 (hand-offs, project residents, project-finished pull-ins, keep-moving rows for leaf sub-projects when `plan.keep_moving` is enabled, and configured `relations.successor_labels` standing offers on managed Done and on Unlink of a Pending task with no live Task Link left today through `api.offerParkedSuccessors` (api v4)) — dependency and project offers gated on `[id::]`, relation offers from accepted LINKS even without ids — through open editors or preimage-checked vault writes, honouring `plan.link_unblocked` — and reports the result through nav `api.notice` v3 for relation and keep-moving rows (plain relation copy when notice is older than v3), the existing Unblocked card for other rows, the walk toast on review landings, or a plain notice without a compatible nav API. Reopening the predecessor the same day through Ctrl+Enter takes back untouched successor links and restores their statuses from an in-memory receipt; Alt+]/Alt+[ moves into Done join the same pass, while moves into Cancelled recover only. Project Schedule comes from the ^prj task; tagged #prj_is_blocked residents stay Blocked until project recovery, which strips the tag from every open resident including those that remain Blocked for their own reasons, never edits closed lines, and records [unblocked::] through ledger-tools v12 when available (otherwise it recovers with a console warning, including on the successor apply path). Alt+] / Alt+[ on a [?] ^prj that leaves the project with no remaining reason — a future date or an open Depends-On target resolved against the vault; a missing id never blocks — recover those open residents in the same gesture, including when Alt+[ cancels ^prj so the note is no longer project(T), and when the cycled ^prj is transcluded from another note. A tagged #prj_is_blocked ^prj inherits its parent project’s Blocked reason and cannot be cycled; closing its last open sub-project pulls in the parent ^prj. LINKS and LINKED FROM rows are not Pomodoro Task Links; Ctrl+Enter and Alt+] / Alt+[ act on their target root-only without formatting the row. Ctrl+Enter on a timed Pomodoro stamps the closed row `[off:: Nm]` when every Task Link it keeps is `#offclock` (aliases `#off-clock`, `#untracked`) and `[t:: Nm]` otherwise, with a notice when a session stays on the clock while linking an off-clock task; timed MEET closes place the carried continuation after the last open Pomodoro and leave the cursor on the next open entry.
